title: 1.2.2 Captions (Prerecorded) mini-assessment
description: Complete after the required lesson activity.

elements.name: q_1
elements.title: A warning tone changes the meaning of a video scene. What should captions include?
elements.explanation: Captions convey meaningful sounds as well as speech.

elements.name: q_2
elements.title: What makes captions different from a separate transcript?
choices: They are synchronized with the media
elements.correctAnswer: They are synchronized with the media
elements.explanation: Captions connect the text to the corresponding moment.

elements.name: q_3
elements.title: When does the text-alternative exception apply?
choices: When the media is a clearly labeled media alternative for text
Whenever the page has a heading
elements.correctAnswer: When the media is a clearly labeled media alternative for text
elements.explanation: The exception requires the specific relationship and clear identification.
